name: Psychic Fangs
effect: Biting. Ignores Screens. Reduce the duration of Screens on the target's side of the battlefield by 2 Rounds. On a Critical Strike, reduce the duration by 3 Rounds instead. If the target is behind any active Screens when performed, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: The Pokemon bares its fangs to bite the foe, psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.
